comments.text: 5:49 Yes, grocery prices are really high right now but that’s exactly why shoplifting and people scamming the system by exploiting glitches like this is such a problem! It’s not like I’m stealing from a small business.” Or something along the lines of that. Those statements are categorically false! These big corporations are always going to recover any and all lost profits, and they are going to do it by raising prices. The only people harmed by shoplifting and scams are the average consumer that follows the law and pays for their items! Every single time someone steals something (and let’s be clear - exploiting a glitch in the system that gives you free stuff is absolutely stealing!) you are not screwing over some big company, you are screwing your neighbors over! Stop using high grocery prices as a way to justify your theft because you and your behavior directly impact those high grocery prices!
